PR #8's head contains the complete IJ-SDK asset line: digest-verified model manifest for S1/S2/S3/R1/R2, gfx1100 engine/backend qualification evidence (P1 PASS), admission smoke tooling, and the parent Atlas datasets (TC-V2, MULTITOOL-V1, AGENTIC-PLAN-V1, JOB-V1) inherited through frozen source fe56f324. The IJ-SLM branch (PR #9) carries newer Atlas assets but not the IJ-SDK assets, and is the active GPU-lease mission; it is documented as a coordination dependency instead of a source base. No rebase onto moving parents; no modification of PR #6, PR #8 or PR #9 branches.
